guide.title: The Complete Ziyarat Guide
guide.subtitle: A rich, respectful guide to the sacred sites - Makkah, the steps of Umrah and Hajj, the blessed sites, Taif, Madinah and Badr - available in every language, free to read and download.
guide.intro: Whether this is your first visit or your tenth, this guide walks you through the holy places and their history so your Ziyarat is meaningful and informed. Choose your language below to begin.

makkah.title: Makkah
makkah.desc: An introduction to the holy city, the Ka'bah and the Sacred Mosque.

umrah.title: Umrah, Step by Step
umrah.desc: The rites of Umrah explained clearly, in order.

hajj.title: Hajj, Step by Step
hajj.desc: A day-by-day walkthrough of the pilgrimage.

sacredSites.title: Sacred Sites of Makkah
sacredSites.desc: The blessed places and historic sites to visit.

taif.title: Taif
taif.desc: The mountain city and its place in the Prophet's ﷺ life.

madinah.title: Madinah
madinah.desc: The Prophet's ﷺ city, Masjid an-Nabawi and its Ziyarat.

badr.title: Badr
badr.desc: The site of the first great battle and its martyrs.

family.title: The Prophet's ﷺ Family
family.desc: An appendix on the wives and children of the Prophet ﷺ.
